message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass and 0 fail.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` (already applied in production) creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`, so inserts failed with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** I changed the two column references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`. The API's returned shape (`fullName`) is unchanged. I did not touch `migrations/`, and `git status` shows `src/api/users.js` as the only modified file.

Nothing else needed changing. I did not commit.
